title: Navigation that makes room for the roster
summary: A roomier bottom bar sits against the screen edge and moves out of the way while you read.
changes: Gives the five navigation controls more breathing room without leaving a floating gap below the bar.
Hides phone navigation while scrolling down, then brings it back on upward scroll or at the page end.
Keeps navigation available in Chat, for keyboard focus and when opening another screen.
Updates the tutorial with the new scrolling behaviour while preserving iPhone safe areas.
